source.source_name: YouTube, Gogumafarm, Careet, Naver SNS/content trend crawl

curation.selection_policy: Platform-level cleaned candidates and keyword terms were prepared from crawled trend data. Null values, duplicates, and unnecessary columns were removed where applicable.

preprocessing_steps: merge candidates from youtube, gogumafarm, careet, and naver
normalize source-specific signals into signal score
match query terms against candidate titles, contexts, and metadata
rank candidates by signal score, query relevance, and recency
keep candidates ranked without manual review
export flat CSV result for Airflow-friendly validation

cross_platform_signal_top_candidates.query: 니가 좋아 밈을 활용한 여름 카페 신메뉴 숏폼 광고
cross_platform_signal_top_candidates.score_policy: Candidates from four platforms are merged, scored with signal-based score, and exported as top candidates.
cross_platform_signal_top_candidates.top_candidate_policy: The current artifact keeps top candidates after signal score ranking. The exact top-N retention rule should be fixed in a later version.

limitations: The current export file is generated from a single demo query, so it is not a full global trend ranking dataset.
Only top candidates after signal score ranking are included.
The ranking stage is automated and has not been manually reviewed.
Instagram data is not included because collection was blocked by policy or access limitations.
Some source URLs or platform-specific metadata may be empty depending on the source.
next_version_plan: Create a broader weekly sns_trend release with stable platform schema, full cross-platform signal scoring, and an explicit top-N retention policy for large outputs.
